question.prompt: What URL should runnable browser tests expect when the footer's `Contact & support` link opens the support page?

options.label: Use {{contact_page_url}}
options.detail: Treat the existing `contact_page_url` variable as the authoritative support-page URL and require its value before execution.

options.label: Provide literal URL later
options.detail: Supply a concrete contact-page URL in a later rerun or supporting source.

options.label: Defer support-route proof
options.detail: Keep the support-route test blocked until a source or run configuration names the URL.

content.risk_rationale: The footer-link route can be checked only if the expected support-page destination is known to the test run.
